A 2024 author correction reports partial overlap between images labeled as different experimental conditions in one main figure and two supplementary figure pairs. It says images from one condition were selected for another condition during figure assembly and supplies replacements.

The correction attributes the problem to figure preparation and states that multiple images existed per condition, but the supplied packet contains no independently archived raw image series linking each replacement to its experimental condition.
